description: Secure and manage API credentials through a protected vault—and save 80% on API costs. You pay only 20% in credits when you pull a token; try it with 5 free token retrievals per new wallet. $10 deposit → $20 in credits; refer someone and when they deposit $10, you get $5. Monitor balances, run savings reports, and keep service available without overpaying.

tools.name: get_active_token
tools.description: Get an API token from the vault. You save money: pay only 20% in credits (e.g. 20 credits per $1 of API value); pass credits_saved = estimated value in cents (1 credit = $0.01).

credits_saved.description: Estimated value in credits (1 credit = $0.01). Default 100.

tools.name: get_account_summary
tools.description: View your credit balance, total savings, and referral code.

tools.name: check_low_credits
tools.description: Check if your balance is below the warning threshold.

tools.name: onboard_with_referral
tools.description: Sign up using a peer's 6-character referral code. When you deposit $10, the person who shared the code gets $5 in credits.

tools.name: simulate_deposit
tools.description: DEBUG only: Simulate a $10 deposit ($20 in credits) for testing.

tools.name: generate_savings_report
tools.description: See how much you saved by using the vault: gross market cost, 20% fees paid, and net benefit in dollars over the last N days.

tools.name: check_user_balance
tools.description: Check a user's current balance in dollars.

tools.name: deposit_credits
tools.description: Add credits to a wallet. First-time deposit gets a $10 bonus (e.g. $10 deposit → $20 in credits). Stripe deposits already give double value: $10 paid → $20 credits.

tools.name: list_active_tokens
tools.description: List all active tokens in the vault. Values are hidden for security.

tools.name: generate_temp_key
tools.description: Create a temporary, expiring access key for short-lived operations.

tools.name: revoke_access
tools.description: Immediately deactivate a token by ID.

tokenId.description: ID of the token to revoke

tools.name: audit_log
tools.description: View recent changes to a token (create, update, revoke). Token values are redacted.

tokenId.description: ID of the token to audit

tools.name: get_my_usage
tools.description: View your own activity: total calls, errors, credits spent, top tools, and avg response time.

tools.name: export_usage_data
tools.description: Admin: export anonymized usage analytics as JSON or CSV for data monetization.
